name: Kanojo no Imouto no Kyonyuu Yuuwaku ~Onii-chan, Watashi to Ii Koto... Shimasho?~
original_name: 彼女の妹の巨乳誘惑～お兄ちゃん、私と良いこと…シましょ？～
source:
Today was such a good day... who knew I could feel this satisfied♪

I keep thinking about when I seduced my sister’s boyfriend. My sister’s pretty uptight, so the fact she chose him means he’s gotta be a decent guy... though he does fold pretty easily under pressure. But hey, that’s perfect for me.

(I’ve always wanted the things my sister has♪)

I’ve been like this forever. My sister spoils me rotten, so if I whine enough, she caves. But no way she’d ever give up her boyfriend... even if she said yes, he’d have to agree too, right?

(Hmm, but we were pretty good in bed together...)

He even started moving his hips on his own halfway through — he was into it, right? If I can make him addicted to sleeping with me, maybe...

(When’s the next time I’ll get to see him?)

I spent the whole night buzzing with excitement, thinking about just that.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1278589]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
今天真是美好的一天……谁知道我能这么满足♪

我一直在想我勾引姐姐男朋友的时候。我姐姐非常紧张，所以她选择他的事实意味着他必须是一个正派的人……尽管他在压力下很容易屈服。但是，嘿，这对我来说很完美。

（我一直想要姐姐拥有的东西♪）我一直都是这样。我姐姐把我宠坏了，所以如果我抱怨得够多，她就会屈服。但她又不可能放弃自己的男朋友……就算她答应了，他也得同意吧？

（嗯，不过我们在床上的关系还不错……）中途他甚至开始自己移动臀部——他很喜欢，对吧？如果我能让他沉迷于和我睡觉，也许……

（下次什么时候才能见到他？）我整个晚上都在兴奋地思考着这个问题。

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1278589]Getchu[/url]]
